AND MACT, KOLLEGALA, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS. 3,43,500/- WITH INTEREST AT 6 PERCENT P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL THE DATE OF REALIZATION.

ORAL JUDGMENT Memo filed seeking permission to withdraw the appeal is on record.
Heard Sri.Jayalingayya.M, learned Additional Government Advocate for the appellants.
Learned Additional Government Advocate submits that the matter is settled and therefore, he may be permitted to withdraw the appeal.
Having considered the submission thus made, permission as prayed for is accorded.
NC: 2025:KHC:18734 HC-KAR
The appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
In the light of the withdrawal of the appeal, I.A.No.1/2020 stands dismissed.
